description: This file defines a custom inline math node for a rich text editor, including parsing, rendering, commands, input rules, and paste rules for inline math expressions using dollar delimiters.

classes.name: MathInline
classes.description: A custom inline node for rendering and handling inline math expressions in the editor.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how the node is parsed from HTML, specifically from span tags with class containing 'math-inline'.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how the node is rendered to HTML, creating a span with classes 'math-inline math-node'.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides a command to insert a math inline node at the current selection.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds the math plugin to the editor's plugin system.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules to automatically convert dollar-delimited text into math inline nodes.

methods.name: addPasteRules
methods.description: Defines paste rules to convert pasted dollar-delimited math expressions into math inline nodes.
